name: TurnBasedActor
src_typeComment: One combatant in turn-based battle: links to Health, has an Initiative stat controlling turn order, and lists which ActionDefinitions it can use. Add a UtilityAIBrain alongside this for AI-controlled actors — without one, TurnManager treats this as player-controlled and waits for SubmitPlayerAction(). Self-registers with TurnManager in Awake(); call TurnManager.Instance.StartBattle() from a Start() (not Awake()) elsewhere so every actor has already registered by then.

src_serialized.name: initiative
src_serialized.tooltip: Determines turn order — higher goes first. Turn queue is rebuilt and sorted by this each round.

src_serialized.name: isAlly
src_serialized.tooltip: True for the player's team, false for the enemy team.

src_serialized.name: availableActions
src_serialized.tooltip: Actions this actor can use on its turn (picked by the player, or scored by a UtilityAIBrain if present).

src_members.sig: public Health Health { get; private set; }
